mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, client_message_id, message_type, content) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{messageType}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, send_time FROM message WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
